senses.en: a visible mass of tiny water drops in the sky
a mass of smoke, dust, or similar material in air
to make thoughts or judgment less clear

ex.en: A dark cloud drifted slowly across the afternoon sky.
ex.zh: 一朵乌云缓缓飘过午后的天空。

ex.en: Strong emotions can cloud public judgment when communities debate the benefits and risks of new technologies.
ex.zh: 当社区讨论新技术的利弊时，强烈的情绪可能影响公众的判断。

col: a cloud of dust｜一团尘土
cloud someone's judgment｜影响某人的判断
tip: cloud作动词可指使判断不清，如cloud your judgment。

senses.en: A place where people read or borrow books and other materials.
An organised collection of books, recordings, or digital resources.

ex.en: I borrowed three books from the library after school.
ex.zh: 放学后，我从图书馆借了三本书。

ex.en: Public libraries support lifelong learning by providing free access to books, digital resources, and quiet study spaces.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供书籍、数字资源和安静的学习空间来支持终身学习。

tip: library是借阅书籍的图书馆，bookshop是售书的书店。

senses.en: the day after Wednesday and before Friday

ex.en: We usually meet for lunch at home on Thursday.
ex.zh: 我们通常周四在家一起吃午饭。

ex.en: The university will host a public discussion on sustainable transport next Thursday evening.
ex.zh: 这所大学将于下周四晚举办一场关于可持续交通的公众讨论会。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；具体某天前用on。

senses.en: Inside a building, or into a building.

ex.en: We stayed indoors and played chess during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间，我们待在室内下棋。

ex.en: Children who spend most of their time indoors may have fewer opportunities for physical activity.
ex.zh: 大部分时间待在室内的孩子可能较少有机会进行体育活动。

col: keep pets indoors｜把宠物养在室内
tip: indoors是副词；修饰名词用indoor，如indoor sports。

senses.en: A room used mainly for sleeping.

ex.en: My bedroom gets plenty of sunlight in the morning.
ex.zh: 我的卧室早晨阳光很充足。

ex.en: Children who share a bedroom may develop cooperation skills, but they also need sufficient privacy as they grow.
ex.zh: 共用卧室的孩子可能会培养合作能力，但随着成长，他们也需要足够的隐私。

tip: 可数名词；a two-bedroom flat指两居室公寓。

senses.en: items worn to cover the body

ex.en: Your clean clothes are drying outside in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 你洗干净的衣服正在外面晒太阳。

ex.en: Buying durable clothes rather than frequently replacing cheap garments can reduce household waste and save resources.
ex.zh: 购买耐穿的衣服，而不是频繁更换廉价服装，可以减少家庭垃圾并节约资源。

tip: 只有复数形式；一件衣服用an item of clothing。

senses.en: A round shape whose edge is equally distant from its centre.
A group of people connected by friendship or shared interests.
To move around something or draw a ring around it.

ex.en: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
ex.zh: 孩子们在草地上围坐成一圈。

ex.en: Joining community activities can help older adults expand their social circle and reduce feelings of isolation.
ex.zh: 参加社区活动可以帮助老年人扩大社交圈，减少孤独感。

tip: circle是圆或圆圈；cycle才常指循环或周期。

senses.en: Used politely to ask someone to repeat what they said.
To forgive someone or officially release them from punishment.
Official forgiveness for a crime, or forgiveness for an offence.

ex.en: Pardon? I couldn't hear you over the washing machine.
ex.zh: 请再说一遍？洗衣机太吵，我没听清。

ex.en: A legal pardon can help someone rebuild their life, although public acceptance may take longer.
ex.zh: 法律上的赦免可以帮助一个人重建生活，但获得公众接纳可能需要更久。

col: I beg your pardon｜请再说一遍；对不起
tip: 没听清时可说Pardon?，语调通常上扬。

senses.en: with care and attention

ex.en: Please read the questions carefully.
ex.zh: 请仔细阅读题目。

ex.en: She carefully carried the glass across the room.
ex.zh: 她小心地把玻璃杯端过房间。

tip: carefully 修饰动词，表示做事仔细小心；反义词是 carelessly。
scene: A student reading a paper closely with a pencil in hand, concentrating.

senses.en: having great physical power or force
not easily broken or damaged
great in intensity, influence, or convincing power

ex.en: My brother is strong enough to lift this sofa.
ex.zh: 我哥哥力气很大，能抬起这张沙发。

ex.en: There is strong evidence that regular physical activity improves both mental health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 有充分证据表明，规律的体育活动能改善心理健康并提高学业表现。

tip: strong at表示擅长；strong通常是形容词。

senses.en: always, or very often

ex.en: He plays computer games all the time.
ex.zh: 他一直都在玩电脑游戏。

ex.en: The baby cries all the time at night.
ex.zh: 宝宝夜里一直哭。

tip: all the time 强调“一直、频繁”，口语中很常用。
scene: A boy glued to a computer screen at home while the clock shows late evening.

senses.en: in or to this place

ex.en: Come here and look at this picture.
ex.zh: 过来看看这张画。

ex.en: Your keys are here on the table.
ex.zh: 你的钥匙在桌上这里。

tip: here you are 是“给你”的口语表达，递交东西时用。
scene: A child pointing to a picture on a table, calling a friend over.

senses.en: The whole physical structure of a person or animal.
An organized group with a particular purpose.
The main or central part of something.

ex.en: My whole body aches after yesterday's long walk.
ex.zh: 昨天走了很长一段路，现在我全身酸痛。

ex.en: An independent body should monitor water quality and publish its findings for the public.
ex.zh: 应由一个独立机构监测水质，并向公众公布调查结果。

col: a body of evidence｜一系列证据
the body of an essay｜文章正文
tip: body可指机构；文章的body指正文部分。

senses.en: A solid piece of material with fairly flat sides.
To stop movement or prevent something from happening.
An area between streets, or a large building.

ex.en: The sculptor carved a bird from a block of wood.
ex.zh: 雕刻家用一块木头雕出了一只鸟。

ex.en: Poorly parked vehicles can block access to public buildings, creating difficulties for wheelchair users.
ex.zh: 停放不当的车辆可能堵住公共建筑的入口，给轮椅使用者带来困难。

col: a block of flats｜一栋公寓楼
a block of ice｜一大块冰
tip: a block of flats指公寓楼，是英式常用表达。

senses.en: one of twelve yearly divisions, or roughly four weeks

ex.en: I put aside a little money every month.
ex.zh: 我每个月都会存下一点钱。

ex.en: Offering employees one additional day off each month could improve wellbeing without significantly reducing overall productivity.
ex.zh: 每月给员工额外一天假期，可以改善他们的身心状态，而不会显著降低整体生产效率。

tip: last、next、every month前通常不加介词。

senses.en: without difficulty or much effort
by a clear margin, especially in comparisons
with a strong possibility of something happening

ex.en: This small suitcase fits easily beneath the train seat.
ex.zh: 这个小行李箱轻轻松松就能放到火车座位下面。

ex.en: Public information should be presented clearly so that people with different literacy levels can easily understand it.
ex.zh: 公共信息应清晰呈现，让识字水平不同的人都能轻松理解。

col: easily accessible｜容易获取或到达的
easily the best｜无疑是最好的
tip: easily可修饰最高级：easily the best表示远胜其他。

senses.en: To allow someone to do something or something to happen.
To allow someone to use property in exchange for rent.

ex.en: Please let me know when you arrive home safely.
ex.zh: 你平安到家后请告诉我。

ex.en: Schools should let students explore different subjects before requiring them to choose a specialist pathway.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生先探索不同学科，再要求他们选择专业方向。

tip: let sb do sth中不加to；过去式、过去分词均为let。

senses.en: water that comes from underground with minerals in it

ex.en: Can I have a bottle of mineral water, please?
ex.zh: 请给我一瓶矿泉水。

ex.en: He drinks mineral water instead of soft drinks.
ex.zh: 他喝矿泉水而不是软饮料。

col: a bottle of mineral water｜一瓶矿泉水
tip: mineral water 指天然矿泉水；sparkling water 是气泡水。
scene: A bottle of mineral water with droplets on it in a picnic basket.

senses.en: A small amount or piece of something.
The smallest unit of information stored by a computer.

ex.en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
ex.zh: 还给你留了一点蛋糕。

ex.en: Even a small bit of practical experience can help students understand difficult scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 即使只有少量实践经验，也能帮助学生理解困难的科学概念。

tip: a bit of接名词；a bit可修饰形容词；bit也是bite过去式。

senses.en: A collection of recorded music released as one product.
A book for keeping photographs, stamps or similar collections.

ex.en: Her new album kept us singing all afternoon.
ex.zh: 她的新专辑让我们跟着唱了整整一个下午。

ex.en: Digital platforms allow independent musicians to release an album without relying on a traditional record company.
ex.zh: 数字平台让独立音乐人无需依赖传统唱片公司就能发行专辑。

tip: 音乐专辑用album；单曲用single。

senses.en: a small round disc that stores music or data

ex.en: This CD has my favourite songs on it.
ex.zh: 这张光盘里有我最喜欢的歌。

ex.en: Do you still buy CDs or do you stream music?
ex.zh: 你还买光盘吗，还是在线听音乐？

tip: CD 是 compact disc 的缩写，复数形式是 CDs。
scene: A shiny music CD lying on a table next to a music player.

senses.en: used when a female does something to herself

ex.en: She made the cake herself.
ex.zh: 蛋糕是她自己做的。

ex.en: She looked at herself in the mirror.
ex.zh: 她照了照镜子。

tip: by herself 表示“独自、靠自己”；反身代词指代主语的自己。
scene: A girl looking at her reflection in a full-length mirror.

senses.en: Brought into the world as a baby
Having a natural ability for a particular activity

ex.en: My little sister was born on a snowy morning.
ex.zh: 我的小妹妹出生在一个下雪的早晨。

ex.en: Children born in rural areas may face greater difficulties accessing specialist healthcare than those in cities.
ex.zh: 与城市儿童相比，出生在农村的儿童获得专科医疗服务可能更加困难。

col: be born into a family｜出生在某个家庭
a born leader｜天生的领导者
tip: 出生用be born；过去出生说was/were born。

senses.en: a coloured substance spread on surfaces for protection or decoration
to cover a surface with paint
to create a picture using paint

ex.en: There is blue paint all over your hands.
ex.zh: 你的双手沾满了蓝色颜料。

ex.en: Schools should allow children to paint regularly, as creative activities can support emotional development and self-expression.
ex.zh: 学校应让孩子经常绘画，因为创意活动有助于情感发展和自我表达。

col: a coat of paint｜一层油漆
tip: paint多指用颜料画；draw多指用铅笔等画线条。

senses.en: to move over snow wearing long narrow boards on your feet
a long narrow board worn on a foot for travelling over snow

ex.en: We learned to ski on a gentle snowy slope.
ex.zh: 我们在一处平缓的雪坡上学会了滑雪。

ex.en: Tourists who ski in mountain resorts contribute to local employment but may also increase environmental pressure.
ex.zh: 在山地度假区滑雪的游客促进了当地就业，但也可能增加环境压力。

col: a pair of skis｜一副滑雪板
tip: 过去式skied，现在分词skiing；ski复数为skis。

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable.

senses.zh: 令人惊叹的；令人敬畏的
senses.en: Causing great admiration, wonder, or sometimes fear.

ex.en: The mountain view from our tent was absolutely awesome.
ex.zh: 从我们的帐篷望出去，山景简直棒极了。

ex.en: The awesome power of volcanic eruptions highlights the importance of effective monitoring systems in nearby communities.
ex.zh: 火山喷发令人敬畏的威力凸显了周边社区建立有效监测系统的重要性。

tip: 表示“超棒”时较口语；正式写作宜选更具体的词。

senses.en: funny or connected with comedy
a publication telling stories through sequences of pictures
a performer who entertains people by making them laugh

ex.en: His comic dance had everyone laughing at the party.
ex.zh: 他那滑稽的舞蹈逗得聚会上的每个人都笑了。

ex.en: Comic characters can make educational programmes more engaging and help children remember important information.
ex.zh: 滑稽的角色可以让教育节目更有吸引力，帮助儿童记住重要信息。

tip: comic可指喜剧相关；comical侧重滑稽可笑。

senses.en: the person speaking or writing

ex.en: I am eleven years old.
ex.zh: 我十一岁。

ex.en: I like playing basketball with my friends.
ex.zh: 我喜欢和朋友们打篮球。

tip: 英语中 I 永远大写；宾格是 me。
scene: A girl pointing to herself and smiling in front of a mirror.

senses.en: To do something with a tool, resource, or method.
The act of employing something for a purpose.
A purpose something serves or a way it can help.

ex.en: Can I use your scissors to open this package?
ex.zh: 我可以用你的剪刀打开这个包裹吗？

ex.en: Governments should encourage people to use public transport by making services more reliable and affordable.
ex.zh: 政府应提高公共交通服务的可靠性和可负担性，鼓励人们使用公共交通。

col: use public transport｜使用公共交通
a wide range of uses｜多种用途
tip: 动词读/juːz/，名词读/juːs/。

senses.en: A period of sixty seconds, or a very short time
A written record of what happened at a meeting
Extremely small in size or amount

ex.en: Wait a minute while I find my keys.
ex.zh: 等一下，我找找钥匙。

ex.en: Even a minute of regular classroom discussion can encourage students to reflect on what they have learned.
ex.zh: 即使每次只进行一分钟的常规课堂讨论，也能鼓励学生反思所学内容。

col: at the last minute｜在最后一刻
tip: 会议记录用复数minutes；形容词“微小的”重音在后。

senses.en: a person who shows tourists around a place

ex.en: The tour guide showed us around the old town.
ex.zh: 导游带我们游览了老城。

ex.en: Our tour guide speaks three languages.
ex.zh: 我们的导游会说三种语言。

tip: tour guide 是带游客参观的导游。
scene: A tour guide with a flag leading tourists through an old town.

senses.en: Used to emphasise something surprising or unexpected.
Flat, regular, or equal in amount or level.
Divisible by two without leaving a remainder.

ex.en: Everyone joined the dance, even our shy uncle.
ex.zh: 大家都加入了舞蹈，连我们害羞的叔叔也不例外。

ex.en: Even small improvements in public transport can make daily travel easier for people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 即使公共交通只有小幅改善，也能让行动不便者的日常出行更加轻松。

tip: even if表假设“即使”；even though表事实“尽管”。

senses.en: Used after a number to give the exact hour.

ex.en: Please meet me outside the library at three o'clock.
ex.zh: 请三点整在图书馆外面和我见面。

ex.en: Starting school at nine o'clock rather than earlier may help teenagers concentrate better during morning lessons.
ex.zh: 将上学时间定在九点而非更早，可能有助于青少年在上午上课时更专注。

tip: 只用于整点；写作o'clock，不用连字符。

senses.en: plan how something will look or work before making it
the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan
a decorative pattern on an object or surface

ex.en: My cousin designed a wooden desk for her bedroom.
ex.zh: 我表姐为自己的卧室设计了一张木书桌。

ex.en: Cities should design public spaces that encourage social interaction while remaining accessible to people with disabilities.
ex.zh: 城市应设计既能促进社交互动、又方便残障人士使用的公共空间。

col: be designed to do something｜旨在做某事
tip: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

senses.en: giving much light or having a strong, clear colour
quick to learn and understand things
promising success or showing happiness

ex.en: Bright sunlight streamed through the kitchen window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，明亮的阳光从厨房窗户照了进来。

ex.en: Access to quality education can give young people a bright future regardless of their family background.
ex.zh: 无论家庭背景如何，获得优质教育都能让年轻人拥有光明的未来。

tip: 形容光线强用bright；形容房间暗用dim。

senses.en: A person who manages workers or runs a business.
To order people around in an annoying or controlling way.

ex.en: My boss let me leave early for my appointment.
ex.zh: 我的上司允许我提前下班去赴约。

ex.en: A supportive boss can improve employee satisfaction by offering constructive feedback and recognising individual contributions.
ex.zh: 支持员工的上司可以通过提供建设性反馈和认可个人贡献来提高员工满意度。

col: talk to your boss｜与你的上司交谈
a supportive boss｜支持员工的上司
be your own boss｜自己当老板
boss someone around｜对某人指手画脚
tip: boss较口语；作动词常用boss someone around。

senses.en: title for a doctor or someone with a doctorate

ex.en: Dr Smith will see you at ten.
ex.zh: 史密斯医生十点见你。

ex.en: She wants to become a Dr when she grows up.
ex.zh: 她长大后想成为博士。

tip: Dr 是 doctor 的缩写，用在姓名前表示尊称。
scene: A doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope smiling in a clinic.

senses.en: A place where ships load, unload, or shelter.
A physical connection point or virtual channel for computer communication.
The left side of a ship or aircraft, facing forward.

ex.en: We watched fishing boats returning to the port.
ex.zh: 我们看着渔船返回港口。

ex.en: Expanding the port could increase international trade, but it may also damage nearby marine habitats.
ex.zh: 扩建港口可能促进国际贸易，但也可能破坏附近的海洋生境。

tip: port指左舷时，反义词是starboard（右舷）。

senses.en: A four-stringed instrument held under the chin and usually bowed.

ex.en: My sister practises the violin after dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后都练习小提琴。

ex.en: Learning the violin can help children develop concentration, although regular lessons may be expensive for some families.
ex.zh: 学习小提琴有助于儿童培养专注力，但定期上课对某些家庭来说可能费用较高。

col: a violin concerto｜小提琴协奏曲
tip: 小提琴手是violinist；拉小提琴常说play the violin。

senses.en: to try to find something

ex.en: I am looking for my keys. Have you seen them?
ex.zh: 我在找我的钥匙，你看见了吗？

ex.en: She is looking for a summer job.
ex.zh: 她在找暑期工作。

tip: look for 是“寻找”的过程；find 是“找到”的结果。
scene: A girl searching through her bag looking for her keys.

senses.en: divide or remove something using a sharp tool
reduce the amount, size, or length of something
an opening made by something sharp, or a reduction

ex.en: She cut the apple into slices for her brother.
ex.zh: 她把苹果切成片给弟弟吃。

ex.en: Local councils can cut energy costs by installing efficient lighting in public buildings.
ex.zh: 地方议会可以通过在公共建筑内安装节能照明设备来削减能源开支。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为cut；现在分词为cutting。

senses.en: A hand covering with separate sections for fingers and thumb.

ex.en: I found my missing glove under the kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我在厨房椅子下面找到了丢失的那只手套。

ex.en: Healthcare workers should change disposable gloves between patients to reduce the risk of spreading infections.
ex.zh: 医护人员在接诊不同患者之间应更换一次性手套，以降低传播感染的风险。

col: a pair of gloves｜一副手套
tip: 一副手套用 a pair of gloves，注意 gloves 用复数。

senses.en: to finish doing something or filling in information
having every necessary part, with nothing missing
total, without any limit or exception

ex.en: I completed the puzzle just before dinner was ready.
ex.zh: 我刚拼好拼图，晚饭就做好了。

ex.en: Students who complete vocational training often gain practical skills that help them enter the workforce more confidently.
ex.zh: 完成职业培训的学生往往能获得实用技能，从而更有信心地进入职场。

tip: complete a form指填写完表格，不是制作表格。

senses.en: Keep information in your mind or bring it back.
Not forget to do something necessary.
Honour someone or something from the past.

ex.en: I still remember the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
ex.zh: 我至今还记得祖母厨房里的气味。

ex.en: Students often remember new vocabulary more effectively when they use it in meaningful conversations.
ex.zh: 学生在有意义的对话中使用新词汇，往往能更有效地记住它们。

col: remember to do something｜记得去做某事
remember doing something｜记得做过某事
tip: remember to do是记得去做；doing是记得做过。

senses.en: to touch someone or something with your lips affectionately
an affectionate touch made with the lips

ex.en: She kissed her daughter gently before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 她上班前轻轻亲了亲女儿。

ex.en: In some cultures, a kiss on the cheek is a common greeting between close friends.
ex.zh: 在一些文化中，亲吻脸颊是亲密朋友之间常见的问候方式。

col: kiss someone goodbye｜亲吻某人道别
give someone a kiss｜亲某人一下
a kiss on the cheek｜脸颊上的一吻
tip: 吻某人的脸颊用 kiss someone on the cheek。

senses.en: to stop sleeping, or make someone stop sleeping
the disturbed water left behind a moving boat
a gathering to remember someone who has recently died

ex.en: Please wake me before you leave for work.
ex.zh: 请在你出门上班前叫醒我。

ex.en: People who wake at consistent times may find it easier to maintain healthy sleep patterns.
ex.zh: 在固定时间醒来的人可能更容易保持健康的睡眠规律。

col: in the wake of｜紧随……之后；受……影响
tip: 过去式woke，过去分词woken；常与up连用。

senses.en: liquid obtained from fruit or vegetables

ex.en: She squeezed fresh orange juice into a glass.
ex.zh: 她把鲜橙汁挤进了玻璃杯里。

ex.en: Although fruit juice contains vitamins, eating whole fruit usually provides more fibre and helps limit sugar intake.
ex.zh: 虽然果汁含有维生素，但吃完整的水果通常能摄入更多膳食纤维，并有助于限制糖分摄入。

tip: juice通常不可数；点餐时a juice可指一杯果汁。

senses.en: Room available for something, or a gap between things
The vast area beyond Earth's atmosphere
To arrange things with gaps between them

ex.en: There is enough space for your bike beside mine.
ex.zh: 我的自行车旁边有足够的地方放你的车。

ex.en: Providing more green space in crowded neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage outdoor physical activity.
ex.zh: 在人口密集的社区增加绿地，可以改善居民身心健康并鼓励户外锻炼。

tip: 泛指空间、太空时不可数；具体车位等可数。

senses.en: Used to make an adjective, adverb, or statement stronger.
In fact, rather than only apparently or supposedly.
Used in questions to express surprise or doubt.

ex.en: This soup is really hot, so let it cool.
ex.zh: 这汤非常烫，先让它凉一凉吧。

ex.en: Before expanding online education, policymakers should consider whether digital courses really meet the needs of disadvantaged learners.
ex.zh: 在扩大在线教育之前，政策制定者应考虑数字课程是否真正满足弱势学习者的需求。

tip: not really通常表示“不太”，语气比直接说no缓和。

senses.en: used to show surprise, understanding or interest

ex.en: Oh, I didn't know you were here!
ex.zh: 哦，我不知道你在这里！

ex.en: Oh, I see. Thank you for explaining.
ex.zh: 哦，我明白了。谢谢你解释。

tip: oh 是语气词，表达惊讶、顿悟等情绪。
scene: A girl looking surprised with her hand near her mouth saying oh.

senses.en: to be careful to avoid danger

ex.en: Look out! There's a car coming.
ex.zh: 小心！有车来了。

ex.en: Look out for wet floors after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后注意湿滑的地面。

tip: look out 用于提醒危险，类似 watch out。
scene: A child at a street corner warning a friend as a car approaches.

senses.en: To cook food using dry heat, especially in an oven.
Cooked using dry heat in an oven or over a fire.
A large piece of roasted meat, or a meal containing it.

ex.en: We usually roast potatoes with garlic and fresh herbs.
ex.zh: 我们通常用大蒜和新鲜香草烤土豆。

ex.en: Families can roast seasonal vegetables at home to prepare nutritious meals without relying on highly processed foods.
ex.zh: 家庭可以在家烤时令蔬菜，做出营养丰富的饭菜，而不必依赖高度加工的食品。

tip: roast多用于肉和蔬菜；烤面包、蛋糕通常用bake。

senses.en: a large natural stream of water flowing towards another water body

ex.en: We watched ducks swimming across the river this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我们看着鸭子游过河面。

ex.en: Protecting river ecosystems requires cooperation between farming communities, local industries, and environmental agencies.
ex.zh: 保护河流生态系统需要农业社区、当地企业和环境机构之间的合作。

tip: 河名通常带the，如the River Nile。

senses.en: A large animal used for riding, racing, or pulling loads.

ex.en: The brown horse gently took an apple from my hand.
ex.zh: 那匹棕色的马轻轻地吃走了我手里的苹果。

ex.en: Before motor vehicles became widespread, horses played a central role in farming and transporting goods.
ex.zh: 在机动车普及之前，马在农业和货物运输中发挥着核心作用。

tip: 骑马用ride a horse；on horseback表示骑在马上。

senses.en: a meal eaten around the middle of the day
to eat a meal around midday

ex.en: We ate lunch under a tree beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边的一棵树下吃了午饭。

ex.en: Providing nutritious school lunches can improve children's concentration and support healthier eating habits over time.
ex.zh: 提供营养丰富的学校午餐可以提高儿童的专注力，并帮助他们逐渐养成更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 泛指吃午餐用have lunch，通常不加冠词。

senses.en: used to ask politely or talk about habits

ex.en: Would you like some tea?
ex.zh: 你想喝点茶吗？

ex.en: When I was young, I would play here every day.
ex.zh: 小时候我每天都会在这里玩。

tip: would like 是“想要”的礼貌说法；Would you like...? 是邀请。
scene: A host offering a cup of tea to a guest with a smile.

senses.en: following the length or direction of something
forward from one place towards another
with someone when they go somewhere

ex.en: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
ex.zh: 我们沿着河边散步，看着水里的鸭子。

ex.en: Planting trees along busy roads can provide shade for pedestrians and improve the appearance of urban areas.
ex.zh: 在繁忙道路沿线植树可以为行人遮阴，并改善城市面貌。

col: bring someone along｜带某人一起来
tip: along沿着长线走；across强调从一边横穿到另一边。

senses.en: having greater than average height

ex.en: A tall tree shades our garden in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午，一棵高大的树为我们的花园遮阴。

ex.en: Tall buildings can accommodate more residents, but careful planning is needed to preserve sunlight and public space.
ex.zh: 高层建筑可以容纳更多居民，但需要精心规划，以保留阳光和公共空间。

tip: 人、树、楼通常用tall；山通常用high。

senses.en: in addition to something already mentioned

ex.en: My sister plays tennis and also enjoys swimming.
ex.zh: 我姐姐打网球，也喜欢游泳。

ex.en: Public libraries provide free books, but they also offer valuable spaces for community learning.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费书籍，也为社区学习提供宝贵的空间。

col: not only ... but also｜不仅……而且
tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；不是连词。

senses.en: an outer garment worn for warmth or protection
a layer of paint or another covering substance
cover a surface with a layer of something

ex.en: Hang your wet coat by the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 把你的湿外套挂在厨房门边。

ex.en: Applying a protective coat to metal structures can reduce maintenance costs and extend their useful life.
ex.zh: 给金属结构涂上保护层可以降低维护成本，延长其使用寿命。

col: a coat of paint｜一层油漆
tip: 动词常用coat A with B，意为给A涂上B。

senses.en: to tolerate something unpleasant or carry a heavy responsibility
a large, heavily built mammal with thick fur
to have or display a particular feature or mark

ex.en: I can't bear the noise of that old fan.
ex.zh: 我受不了那台旧风扇的噪声。

ex.en: Low-income households often bear the greatest burden when the cost of essential goods rises.
ex.zh: 生活必需品价格上涨时，低收入家庭往往承受最沉重的负担。

tip: 过去式bore；过去分词通常borne；出生用born。

senses.en: A valuable yellow metal used for jewellery and money
The medal awarded for first place in a competition
Made of gold or having its yellow colour

ex.en: My grandmother keeps her gold ring in a wooden box.
ex.zh: 我奶奶把她的金戒指放在一个木盒里。

ex.en: Demand for gold can increase during economic uncertainty, as investors seek assets they consider relatively safe.
ex.zh: 经济不确定时期，投资者会寻求他们认为相对安全的资产，黄金需求因此可能上升。

tip: gold作材料名通常不可数；a gold可指一枚金牌。

senses.en: the job of washing the dishes

ex.en: It's your turn to do the washing-up tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚轮到你洗碗了。

ex.en: The washing-up is done and the kitchen is clean.
ex.zh: 碗洗完了，厨房很干净。

tip: do the washing-up 是“洗碗”的英式说法。
scene: Clean dishes drying on a rack above a kitchen sink.

senses.en: a thin, flat piece cut from something larger
to cut something into thin, flat pieces
a share or portion of something

ex.en: She put a slice of lemon in my tea.
ex.zh: 她在我的茶里放了一片柠檬。

ex.en: Housing costs consume a large slice of household income, leaving many families with little money for leisure.
ex.zh: 住房开支占据家庭收入的很大一部分，使许多家庭几乎没有钱用于休闲。

col: a slice of bread｜一片面包
a slice of the market｜一部分市场份额
tip: slice强调切出的片；piece泛指一块或一件。

senses.en: A very large animal with a long trunk and large ears.

ex.en: The elephant sprayed water over its back with its trunk.
ex.zh: 大象用鼻子把水喷到自己的背上。

ex.en: Protecting elephant habitats requires cooperation between conservation organisations, local communities, and governments across national borders.
ex.zh: 保护大象栖息地需要保护组织、当地社区和各国政府开展跨国合作。

col: a herd of elephants｜一群大象
tip: 复数为elephants；象鼻用trunk，不用nose。

senses.en: moving or happening at high speed
at high speed or within a short time
to eat no food for a period of time

ex.en: We caught a fast train and arrived before lunch.
ex.zh: 我们赶上了一班快车，在午饭前就到了。

ex.en: Fast internet connections allow rural businesses to reach wider markets and compete with companies in major cities.
ex.zh: 高速网络连接使乡村企业能够进入更广阔的市场，并与大城市的公司竞争。

tip: fast本身可作副词，不能说fastly。

senses.en: in what way; used in questions

ex.en: How do you go to school?
ex.zh: 你怎么去上学？

ex.en: How beautiful the flowers are!
ex.zh: 这些花多漂亮啊！

tip: how many + 可数名词；how much + 不可数名词或问价格。
scene: A child asking a question with a raised hand in a classroom.

senses.en: showing where someone or something starts or originates
showing what causes something
showing separation, difference, or distance

ex.en: This postcard came from my cousin in the mountains.
ex.zh: 这张明信片是住在山区的表亲寄来的。

ex.en: Students from rural communities may face additional barriers when applying to universities in major cities.
ex.zh: 来自农村社区的学生申请大城市的大学时，可能面临额外障碍。

col: from start to finish｜从头到尾
tip: from表示起点，常与表示终点的to搭配。

senses.en: At a fast speed or after only a short time.

ex.en: We quickly packed our bags when the taxi arrived.
ex.zh: 出租车一到，我们就迅速收拾好了行李。

ex.en: Cities must respond quickly to extreme weather events to protect vulnerable residents and maintain essential services.
ex.zh: 城市必须迅速应对极端天气事件，以保护弱势居民并维持基本服务。

tip: quickly是副词，修饰动作；quick是形容词，修饰名词。

senses.en: a smaller amount of something
to a smaller degree or extent
a smaller amount

ex.en: Please put less sugar in my tea this time.
ex.zh: 这次请在我的茶里少放点糖。

ex.en: Households can use less energy by improving insulation and choosing appliances that consume electricity more efficiently.
ex.zh: 家庭可以通过改善隔热措施和选用更节能的电器来减少能源消耗。

tip: 修饰不可数名词用less；可数名词复数通常用fewer。

senses.en: Damaged by being split or separated into pieces.
Not working properly because of damage.
Spoken with difficulty and frequent pauses or errors.

ex.en: She carefully swept the broken glass into a dustpan.
ex.zh: 她小心地把碎玻璃扫进簸箕里。

ex.en: Repairing broken household appliances rather than replacing them can reduce waste and conserve valuable natural resources.
ex.zh: 维修损坏的家用电器而非更换它们，可以减少废弃物并节约宝贵的自然资源。

col: a broken promise｜未兑现的承诺
tip: 也是break的过去分词；过去式为broke。

senses.en: a large area of land covered mainly with trees

ex.en: We followed a narrow path deep into the forest.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走进森林深处。

ex.en: Protecting natural forests helps preserve biodiversity and reduces the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 保护天然森林有助于维护生物多样性，并减少大气中的二氧化碳含量。

tip: forest通常指大片森林；wood也可指较小树林。

senses.en: finely chopped meat enclosed in a thin, tube-shaped skin

ex.en: We grilled sausages and served them with fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 我们烤了香肠，配上新鲜蔬菜端上桌。

ex.en: Consumers are increasingly choosing vegetarian sausages as they seek alternatives to traditional meat products.
ex.zh: 随着消费者寻找传统肉制品的替代品，越来越多人开始选择素香肠。

tip: 单根香肠可数；sausage meat指香肠肉馅，不可数。

senses.en: Something people do for enjoyment, learning, or a particular purpose.
The state of being busy or doing things.

ex.en: Painting is my favourite activity on rainy afternoons.
ex.zh: 下雨的午后，我最喜欢的活动是画画。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several long-term illnesses.
ex.zh: 经常进行体育活动可以改善心理健康，并降低患多种慢性疾病的风险。

tip: 具体活动可数；泛指活跃或活动量时不可数。

senses.en: an animal like a small horse with long ears

ex.en: A grey donkey carried baskets along the narrow mountain path.
ex.zh: 一头灰驴驮着篮子走在狭窄的山路上。

ex.en: In some rural communities, donkeys remain important for transporting goods where roads are unsuitable for vehicles.
ex.zh: 在一些乡村社区，道路不适合车辆通行，驴仍是运输货物的重要工具。

tip: 指动物时donkey最常用；用来称呼人有贬义。

senses.en: A settlement usually larger than a village but smaller than a city
The central area where people go shopping or do business

ex.en: Our town has a bakery beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们镇的老桥旁有一家面包店。

ex.en: Improving public transport in a small town can help residents access jobs and essential services.
ex.zh: 改善小城镇的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会和基本服务。

tip: go into town指去市中心，此时town前不加冠词。

senses.en: living or growing naturally, without human care
showing strong excitement or uncontrolled behaviour
natural places where animals and plants live freely

ex.en: We spotted wild deer drinking beside the forest stream.
ex.zh: 我们看见野鹿在森林的小溪旁喝水。

ex.en: Protecting wild animals requires governments to preserve habitats and reduce illegal trade across national borders.
ex.zh: 保护野生动物需要各国政府保护栖息地，并减少跨境非法贸易。

tip: 表示“在野外”用in the wild，不能漏掉the。

senses.en: not having, using, or being accompanied by someone or something
not doing the action mentioned

ex.en: I left the house without my keys this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我出门时没带钥匙。

ex.en: Cities cannot achieve lasting reductions in air pollution without investing in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 如果不投资可靠的公共交通，城市就无法持久地减少空气污染。

col: without saying a word｜一言不发地
tip: without 是介词，后接名词、代词或动词-ing。

senses.en: informal word for father

ex.en: My dad cooks dinner on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我爸爸周日做晚饭。

ex.en: Dad, can I play outside?
ex.zh: 爸爸，我能去外面玩吗？

tip: dad 是口语中称呼爸爸的常用词；mum 是妈妈。
scene: A father cooking in a kitchen while a child watches happily.

senses.en: an image made by drawing, painting, or taking a photograph
an idea or description of what a situation is like
to form an image of someone or something in your mind

ex.en: She hung a picture of the sea above her bed.
ex.zh: 她在床头上方挂了一幅海景画。

ex.en: Survey results provide a clearer picture of how housing costs affect the wellbeing of young adults.
ex.zh: 调查结果更清楚地呈现了住房成本如何影响年轻成年人的幸福感。

col: picture yourself doing something｜想象自己做某事
tip: take a picture是拍照；draw a picture是画画。

senses.en: a young person who has not yet become an adult
someone's son or daughter, regardless of age

ex.en: The child carefully carried a bowl of water outside.
ex.zh: 那个孩子小心翼翼地端着一碗水走到外面。

ex.en: Every child should have access to quality education, regardless of family income or place of residence.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都应享有优质教育，不论其家庭收入或居住地点如何。

tip: 复数是children；childish偏贬义，childlike指天真如孩童。

senses.en: the middle part of a city where shops and offices are

ex.en: The museum is in the city centre.
ex.zh: 博物馆在市中心。

ex.en: We took the bus to the city centre.
ex.zh: 我们坐公交车去市中心。

tip: city centre 是英式说法；美式常说 downtown。
scene: A busy city centre street with shops, a museum and people walking.

senses.en: The currency used by many countries in the European Union.

ex.en: I found a euro in my coat pocket today.
ex.zh: 今天我在外套口袋里发现了一枚一欧元硬币。

ex.en: Using the euro allows tourists to visit several European countries without exchanging money at each border.
ex.zh: 使用欧元让游客能够游览多个欧洲国家，而不必每过一次边境就兑换货币。

tip: 普通英语中复数通常为euros；并非所有欧盟国家都用欧元。

senses.en: Caring about others and willing to help them.
A group of things sharing similar features.

ex.en: Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
ex.zh: 我们生病时，体贴的邻居给我们送来了汤。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to be kind to others, helping create a more supportive learning environment.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生善待他人，帮助营造更有支持性的学习环境。

col: be kind to someone｜善待某人
tip: 形容词常接to；种类用a kind of加名词。

senses.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for books.

ex.en: She keeps her favourite novels in a wooden bookcase.
ex.zh: 她把最喜欢的小说放在一个木书柜里。

ex.en: Placing accessible bookcases in classrooms can encourage children to read independently during their free time.
ex.zh: 在教室里摆放方便取书的书柜，可以鼓励孩子在空闲时间自主阅读。

col: a bookcase full of books｜装满书的书柜
tip: bookcase指整件书柜，bookshelf指书架或一层搁板。

senses.en: a tool with bristles used for cleaning, painting or arranging hair
to clean, paint or arrange something using a brush
to touch something lightly while moving past it

ex.en: Use a soft brush to clean your muddy shoes.
ex.zh: 用软毛刷清理你沾满泥的鞋子。

ex.en: Children should learn to brush their teeth properly, as good habits can prevent many dental problems.
ex.zh: 儿童应学会正确刷牙，因为良好的习惯可以预防许多牙齿问题。

tip: brush against表示轻擦；brush up on表示温习。

senses.en: outside a building, in the open air
the natural world away from buildings

ex.en: The weather is warm enough to eat outdoors tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚天气够暖和，可以在户外吃饭。

ex.en: Spending time outdoors can improve children's wellbeing and encourage greater interest in protecting the natural environment.
ex.zh: 在户外活动能改善儿童的身心健康，并增强他们保护自然环境的兴趣。

tip: outdoors是副词；修饰名词用outdoor，如outdoor activities。

senses.en: Easy to understand or do; not complicated.
Plain and without unnecessary decoration or extra features.

ex.en: This simple recipe takes just ten minutes to prepare.
ex.zh: 这道简单的菜只需十分钟就能做好。

ex.en: Schools should provide simple instructions so that all students can complete classroom tasks independently.
ex.zh: 学校应提供简单易懂的说明，让所有学生都能独立完成课堂任务。

tip: simple可指容易或朴素，不一定表示简陋。

senses.en: not anything; no thing at all
not at all, used to strengthen certain comparisons

ex.en: I opened the fridge, but there was nothing inside.
ex.zh: 我打开冰箱，里面却什么也没有。

ex.en: Without affordable public transport, some residents have nothing to rely on except their own cars.
ex.zh: 如果没有价格合理的公共交通，一些居民除了自己的汽车便无可依靠。

tip: nothing本身含否定意义，通常不再与not连用。

senses.en: the day after Monday and before Wednesday

ex.en: We usually have dinner together on Tuesday evenings.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期二晚上一起吃饭。

ex.en: The community centre offers free language classes every Tuesday to help newcomers settle into the area.
ex.zh: 社区中心每周二提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者适应当地生活。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；every Tuesday前不用on。

senses.en: Up to now, especially in questions and negative statements.
But, despite what has just been stated.
Used to emphasize a further increase or addition.

ex.en: I haven't finished dinner yet, so please wait.
ex.zh: 我还没吃完晚饭，请等一下。

ex.en: Renewable energy is becoming cheaper, yet many countries still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源正在变得更便宜，然而许多国家仍严重依赖化石燃料。

tip: 表示“还未”常用于否定句末；疑问句中可表示“已经”。

senses.en: Below the ground, or operating secretly.
Below the ground, or in a hidden, secret way.
A railway system running mainly beneath a city.

ex.en: We left our car in an underground garage.
ex.zh: 我们把车停在了地下车库。

ex.en: Underground transport systems can ease congestion, although constructing tunnels requires substantial investment and careful planning.
ex.zh: 地铁交通系统能缓解拥堵，但隧道建设需要大量投资和周密规划。

tip: 名词表地铁主要用于英式英语，此时重音在首音节。

senses.en: unwilling to work or make an effort
relaxed and involving little activity

ex.en: I felt too lazy to cook dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我懒得做饭。

ex.en: Students who struggle with homework should not automatically be considered lazy, as learning difficulties may be involved.
ex.zh: 不应一概认为做作业有困难的学生懒惰，因为这可能涉及学习障碍。

tip: lazy afternoon指悠闲的午后，不一定含贬义。

senses.en: used to ask about the reason for something
introduces the reason for a situation or action

ex.en: Why are your shoes still wet this morning?
ex.zh: 为什么你的鞋今天早上还是湿的？

ex.en: Researchers need to understand why some students leave education before completing their secondary school qualifications.
ex.zh: 研究人员需要了解，为什么有些学生尚未取得中学学历就离开了学校。

tip: 间接疑问句用陈述语序：I know why he left。

senses.en: Making someone feel afraid or nervous.

ex.en: That scary noise was just a branch against the window.
ex.zh: 那个吓人的声音只不过是树枝在碰窗户。

ex.en: Starting school can be scary for young children, so teachers should create a welcoming environment.
ex.zh: 开始上学可能让年幼的孩子害怕，因此教师应营造友善的环境。

tip: scary形容事物吓人；scared形容人感到害怕。

senses.en: a covering worn on the head for protection or decoration

ex.en: I grabbed my hat before stepping into the sunshine.
ex.zh: 走到阳光下之前，我拿起了帽子。

ex.en: Wearing a wide-brimmed hat can reduce sun exposure, particularly for people who spend long hours working outdoors.
ex.zh: 戴宽檐帽可以减少日晒，对长时间在户外工作的人尤其有用。

tip: 戴着帽子用wear；戴上帽子的动作用put on。

senses.en: A structure animals build to hold eggs or raise their young.
Build or occupy a nest.

ex.en: A small bird carried twigs to its nest.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟把细树枝衔回巢里。

ex.en: Protecting trees where rare birds nest is essential for maintaining biodiversity in areas affected by urban development.
ex.zh: 在受城市开发影响的地区，保护珍稀鸟类筑巢的树木对维持生物多样性至关重要。

tip: nest既可作名词鸟巢，也可作动词筑巢。

senses.en: A person who works, especially for pay.

ex.en: A worker in orange overalls repaired the broken fence.
ex.zh: 一名穿橙色工作服的工人修好了破损的围栏。

ex.en: Employers should provide every worker with appropriate training and equipment to reduce the risk of workplace injuries.
ex.zh: 雇主应为每位员工提供适当的培训和设备，以降低工伤风险。

tip: 不只指体力劳动者，也可指医护等职业工作者。

senses.en: the son of your son or daughter

ex.en: Her grandson visits every Sunday and helps with cooking.
ex.zh: 她的孙子每周日都来看她，并帮忙做饭。

ex.en: Regular contact with a grandson or granddaughter can help older adults feel more socially connected.
ex.zh: 经常与孙辈联系能帮助老年人增强与社会的联系感。

col: youngest grandson｜最小的孙子或外孙
eldest grandson｜最大的孙子或外孙
tip: 不区分父系与母系，既指孙子也指外孙。

senses.zh: 在任何地方；去任何地方
senses.en: in or to any place
in any place, used in questions and negative statements

ex.en: You can sit anywhere you like in this room.
ex.zh: 在这个房间里，你想坐哪儿都行。

ex.en: Reliable internet access allows employees to work from anywhere, reducing the need for daily commuting.
ex.zh: 可靠的网络连接使员工能够在任何地方工作，减少了每天通勤的必要。

tip: 不定副词，通常不直接作名词；anywhere else指别处。
